extracted.name: Friendship Fruit Starter
extracted.description: Make homemade Friendship Fruit Starter with canned fruit, sugar, and brandy. Use the starter to bake classic Thirty-Day Friendship Cake and enjoy the sweet brandied fruit, too.
instruction_lines: Combine pineapple chunks, apricot halves, sliced peaches, maraschino cherries, brandy, and white sugar in a large glass jar. Stir gently with a wooden spoon until the sugar is combined.
Cover loosely and let stand at room temperature for 3 weeks, stirring at least twice a week.
Drain the fruit, reserving the liquid. The reserved liquid is the starter for Thirty-Day Friendship Cake.
Transfer the brandied fruit to an airtight container and refrigerate until ready to use.
